urls.title: Websites
urls.description: Domains or URLs to extract contacts from, one per line. Bare domains are fine. Also accepts "url" or "startUrls" for compatibility with other Actors.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: How many pages to read per website. The first is the URL you gave; the rest are the site's own contact, imprint, about and team pages, chosen by how likely they are to hold contact details. 1 reads only the page you gave.

includeEmails.title: Emails
includeEmails.description: Extract email addresses, including ones written as "name [at] example [dot] com".

includePhones.title: Phone numbers
includePhones.description: Extract phone numbers and normalise them to E.164, using the site's country as a hint for local formats.

includeSocials.title: Social profiles
includeSocials.description: Extract profile links for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub, Pinterest, Threads, Telegram, WhatsApp and more. Share and intent links are ignored.

includeAddresses.title: Postal addresses
includeAddresses.description: Extract postal addresses from schema.org data and address tags.

timeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a single page after this many seconds.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most sites answer plain datacenter requests, so no proxy is needed in normal use.
